name: Controlled Pilot Evidence Review and Conformance
purpose: Review evidence generated by an authorized controlled pilot against the site admission, operational readiness, DMRV, QMS, custody, source-provenance and governance requirements before any scale promotion.
conformance_rules: all material evidence references resolve to the same site/pilot scope
observations retain source, timestamp, location, method and quality
forecast/modelled/satellite evidence is not promoted to observed evidence
material source conflicts remain unresolved only in HOLD/NONCONFORMING state
corrections create successor records rather than rewriting historical evidence
QMS conclusions remain within the tested scope and method
public claims are limited to the reviewed evidence scope
fail_closed_conditions: QMS result provenance incomplete where required
DMRV package inconsistent with source records

frontend_surface.semantic_rule: A conforming review does not itself establish premium status, regulatory approval or product release.
